designs.title: Goblin workers (Goblin Grubber, Goblin Tinker)
notes: On the owner's direction, the orc farmer and builder are goblins instead of orcs.
About three quarters of an orc's height (0.8 scale against the orc's 1.1), a little faster and frailer.
Sallow yellow-green skin, long ears swept out and back, a hooked nose, slit yellow eyes and a toothy grin.
Plain worker gear in orc colors: a bandana and basket for the Grubber, a leather cap, apron and tool belt for the Tinker.

designs.title: Demon player
notes: Oryx-style head: spiked cowl blades over the shoulders, a sharpened V jaw, a flat mouthless face and a band of violet eyes.
Robe, cloak, forearm brambles and thorns; bare hands and feet.
Wings fold at the elbow: tucked on the ground, half-open in a jump, spread in flight. Flies without an elytra.

designs.title: Imp Impaler and Imp Firecaster
notes: Imps are one demon species, not the whole faction. They fill only the spearman and archer roles.
Small (0.7x), winged, scorpion-tailed, digitigrade.
Impaler: studded harness and bone spikes. Firecaster: rune mantle, ember orb, fire bolts.

designs.title: Workers: farmers, builders, guards
notes: Plain humanoid working folk in the race's colors: straw hats, knit caps or hoods, smocks, aprons, work caps and kettle helms.
No horns, antennae, wings, spikes or crests.

designs.title: The Hive's look
notes: Sculk-dark: deep teal chitin with glowing cyan veins and green-cyan eyes, like the Warden and the deep dark.
The Swarm (enemy Hive faction): black chitin with acid-green veins.
A cave race: stronger below Y=40 and weaker in sunlight; Swarm raids tunnel up near their target; new Hive players start underground.

designs.title: Lancer-Drone (Hive spearman)
notes: Sturdy four-armed ant warrior about player height, on bent-back legs: thick limbs, shoulder plates, a breastplate and a back shell.
Upper arms hold one spear in both hands at the ready: a long haft, a leaf-shaped head and a butt spike, with fists wrapped around the haft. The lower hands have short fingers.
Narrow ant head, big glowing compound eyes, small mandibles, long banded antennae. Ragged shoulder wrap and grass skirt.

designs.title: Deepmaw (Hive war beast)
notes: A lobster centaur, about player height and two and a half blocks long.
Lower body: a long carapace on eight crawling legs, with a finned glowing crest, a segmented tail and a tail fan.
An upright plated torso rises from the front, with thick claw arms held out to the sides that snap in a fight.
Head after the reference: a tall spiked crown with two horns, a heavy brow over a row of glowing eyes, a jutting snout, broad bone tusk-blades and thin fangs.
Summoned at the altar; up to 10 per commander, a limit meant to grow with base level.

designs.title: Bone Stalker (Demon war beast)
notes: Gaunt, bone-white and skeletal, prowling on all fours, with blood-red barbs, talons and spines.
Thin insect-like wings with torn pale membrane, and a long spined tail ending in a scorpion stinger.
Works like the Deepmaw: a rare altar unit. Not built yet.

designs.title: Hellknights (Hellguard, Fiend, Archfiend, Hellknight, Blood Witch)
notes: Built and in the game: the full-sized demon soldiers wear generated armor over the demon body.

Left to right in the render: Blood Witch (healer), Hellknight (Champion), Archfiend (Captain), Fiend (swordsman), Hellguard (shieldbearer), and a Black Legion soldier for comparison. Front row, then from behind.

Faceless black-iron plate with a single ember visor slit, horns breaking out of the helm, ember light along the plate seams, hooves with a backward hock spur on each leg as a hint of a beast's bent leg.

Hellguard: doubled pauldrons, a gorget and a black shield. Archfiend: a crest and a cape. Hellknight: great horns, spiked pauldrons, an ember sigil on the chest, a longer cape. Blood Witch: blood-red robes and hood with ember eyes, light pauldrons, no full plate.
Captains and Champions stand 15% and 30% taller. The Burning Horde wears the same armor in darker colors with brighter embers.

designs.title: Enemy faction trim
notes: Built and in the game: raiders of each faction wear a cosmetic overlay on top of their body and armor. Your own units never do.

Left to right in the render: Fallen Host (torn ash-gray wings, a cracked dim halo), Ironbeard Clan (rune-etched iron face guard, braided beard rings), Silverwood Reavers (pale antler-bone mask, thorn-vine wraps), The Swarm (glowing acid sacs on the back, black chitin spurs), Burning Horde (smoldering chains, a glowing brand, over the hellknight armor), Black Legion (black tabard with a white skull, a spiked pauldron), Marauder Horde (red war paint, bone trophies on belt and shoulders). Front row, then from behind.
No stat changes.

designs.title: Raid chests, one per enemy faction
notes: Built and in the game, at the heart of every siege outpost. Left to right: Marauder war crate (lashed planks), Black Legion strongbox (black iron, steel bands), Burning Horde bone chest (bone slats, ember lock), Swarm chitin pod (black chitin, acid seams), Silverwood root-bound coffer, Ironbeard vault (iron, gold bands, a blue rune), Fallen Host reliquary (tarnished gilt).
First pass from each faction's palette, as no references came in. Send pictures to change any of them.

designs.title: 3D towers, styled per race
notes: Built and in the game. Rows: Arrow Tower (timber watchtower, crenellated parapet with an arrow slit, a pennant), Arcane Spire (tapering stone needle with gold bands, rune panels and a floating mana crystal), Healing Shrine (stepped basin of glowing water under four pillars and a ring, a hovering light).

Left to right: Hive (dark teal chitin, cyan), angel (white stone, gold), demon (black iron, embers), orc (rough timber, green), dwarf (slate, rune blue), elf (pale living wood, green), human (stone, gold, red). Each tower takes its owner's race when placed.
The tower block is the plinth; the model rises two blocks above it. The crystal, runes, water and light glow and move only while the mana network can pay for a shot, and go dark when it can't.
First pass from each race's palette. Send references to change any of them.
